text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ENTRAPMENT?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's scream of despair echoes through the room. It appears her strange-sounding laughter is caused by an illness endemic to Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Epiglottic entrapment is one of the many illnesses that can affect an Umamusume's respiratory tract.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: This one is caused by your aryepiglottic folds—that's the tissue right below your epiglottis—getting displaced when you breathe and blocking your throat.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If they're blocking my throat, then it's no wonder I felt so terrible…

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly. It also causes your breathing to become more labored when you run.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Rest assured that it won't affect your everyday life. Your laugh should go back to normal soon too. However…
choice_data_list: She won't be able to run long distances anymore, will she?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, no. She'll be limited in the distances she can compete in from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: There is surgery, but if you go that route, you won't be able to race while you recover.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: At the very least, you'll have to take a sabbatical of six months.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see… So I either have to deal with a limit on the races I can run or take a hiatus for at least half a year…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well… That's quite the bombshell to get hit with. All I can do is laugh.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I promised Dober that I'd run in the Shuka Sho with her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She doesn't know anything yet. She still thinks she's racing against me…
choice_data_list: I'm guessing you don't want to let her down?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not. But…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's nothing for either of us to gain by running together with me in this sorry state…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So good luck, Dober. Let's meet again somewhere, sometime.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We're not so weak that we can't run on our own, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's time to change directions, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's take the Shuka Sho off my schedule. That path to the rest of the world is no longer viable to me anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes her decision without hesitation. Now our choices are either to push ahead with distance constraints or to pursue surgery and recovery…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am. I can't not consider it. If I can make a complete recovery with surgery…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then that's probably the best thing for my body. But if I choose what's best for me, I'll end up losing other things.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Time, for example… Six months at least, and potentially even more than that. If I do take a hiatus…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It'll take a lot longer to deliver hope to the world. Countless people will give up on their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even if I make a full recovery and become wildly successful after a few years…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It'll already be too late by then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see burning resolve in Seeking the Pearl's eyes—the resolve to accept this hardship.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So… I'm not going to get the surgery. My body isn't meant to be protected.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's meant to achieve its goal! Let's find a way forward even with my distance constraints!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The decision is made. She will continue racing without taking a hiatus, which means…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll have to rethink everything and figure out a way to bring Seeking the Pearl onto the world stage in her current state.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Huff… It looks like a mile is as much as I can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After extensive testing, we pin down the distance Seeking the Pearl can currently run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although we were previously training her for medium-distance races, the best she can do now are sprints, and she can just barely make a mile.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Okay. Now that we know what I'm capable of, we'll be fine. What race should I do next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we're going to run abroad, we have to do a G1. That means…
choice_data_list: Our only option is the Mile Championship.
Our only option is the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship… That's a 1,600-meter race that senior racers also run in…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A logical choice, seeing as it's the only G1 sprint left this year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll do it! I'm not afraid of anything—not even going against experienced veterans!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll grab the gold there and pave the way for my brilliant future in racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our new goal is the Mile Championship. However, it seems like veteran racers aren't the only ones who'll be standing in our way.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look at this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It looks like an Umamusume even stronger than any senior-year racer is going to be running in the Mile Championship. Check out this text I got…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Pearl! How's your throat doin'? I'm doin' fantastic, myself! ☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm plannin' on takin' home a bunch of titles in graded races this fall! ☆ Then I'm gonna take on the Mile Championship and make it mine too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki's been winning races nonstop, and now she's even won graded races. She's on an entirely different level.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She'll probably be going into the Mile Championship in top form and looking to win her first G1.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Honestly, that momentum of hers is terrifying. She's probably more of a threat than the senior-year Umamusume are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is certainly a formidable rival. But with the Mile Championship being the only G1 mile race left this year, she can't afford to skip it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This will be the first showdown between this now-clouded pearl and the shuttle that's launching sky-high. The Mile Championship is shaping up to be a difficult race.
